mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are dealing with heavy rain and 63 degree temperatures near Badger Ridge Middle School under a Waning Gibbous moon.

In city news, the Verona Police Department is streamlining record requests to ensure all paperwork is processed within 10 business days, while the Public Works Department is preparing for road surface treatments on Lincoln Street and Range Trail starting August 4.
There is a lot going on today, including the Remote Area Medical clinic at the high school, the Sugar River Paddle and Jamboree at Seven Acre Dairy, and the Dane County Farmers Market in Madison.
In a noteworthy call from July 23, Verona officers responded to a residence on Lucerne Drive where a 23-year-old man was taken into custody for disorderly conduct and intimidation of a victim.
If you are craving something sweet, today's flavor is Chocolate Volcano. Since the shop is currently closed, you will have to wait until they open at 10:00 AM to get your fix.
